data.title: 中野一花 · 温泉雾气中的温软回眸
data.description: 露天温泉池畔热气缭绕，雪白浴巾贴合着湿润曼妙的身姿。一花微微侧身回首，锁骨挂着晶莹水珠，娇羞而迷人。
data.action: 一花微微侧身回首，锁骨挂着晶莹水珠，娇羞而迷人
data.lighting: soft lantern glow through rising steam
data.promptProse: Soaking in a secluded outdoor rock hot spring on a quiet night, Ichika Nakano glances back over her bare shoulder with a flushed, shy smile while wrapped snugly in a pure white bath towel. Warm lantern light filters softly through rising steam to catch glistening droplets along her collarbone.
data.animaCaption: Soaking in the secluded cedar-and-rock hot spring wrapped in a white bath towel, she turns back over her bare shoulder with a warm, bashful smile as droplets trace her collarbone. Soft wooden lantern light diffuses gently through rising night steam.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a pure white bath towel wrapped snugly around her chest while her bare shoulders and collarbone glisten with warm droplets in the steam.
